title: The Best Recipe
premise: Edmund Galloway, a debate champion whose sharpest arguments crumble at his own kitchen table, is paired with his academic nemesis Priya Raghavan for a semester project on local history. Digging through school archives, they uncover a decades-old cover-up: the school board sold the land beneath the original building — including a beloved community garden Edmund's late mother helped found — to a developer with ties to the board president. As their rivalry thaws into something tenderer, Edmund must choose between the safe future his father has scripted for him and publicly exposing the truth. At prom, he delivers the speech of his life, forcing the board's resignation and finally winning the argument that matters: who he gets to be.
about_author: Casper Dravenmoor is the pen name of a former high-school debater who spent more tournaments in the hallway arguing with judges' decisions than actually competing. Casper writes stories about sharp-tongued teenagers discovering that the hardest cases to win are the ones against the people who love you.

chapters.title: The Assignment
chapters.summary: POV Edmund. Paired with Priya for the semester capstone, Edmund seethes through their first archive session while dodging his father's calls about pre-law summer programs. A flash of grief hits when he passes the fenced-off garden lot where his mother used to take him. Emotional beat: resentment masking exhaustion — he wins every debate except the ones at home.

chapters.title: Buried in Plain Sight
chapters.summary: POV alternating Edmund and Priya. Researching the school's founding for the project, they find a misfiled deed and a 1998 board meeting minutes page with a torn-out section. Their bickering softens into real collaboration over late nights in the library. Emotional beat: reluctant respect turning into connection; Edmund realizes Priya argues like someone who has something to prove too.

chapters.title: What the Board Buried
chapters.summary: POV Edmund. They trace the land sale to Board President Halloway's development company and discover Edmund's mother led the petition that tried to stop it — before her accident. When Edmund confronts his father, he learns Dad knew and stayed silent to protect his career. Emotional beat: betrayal and fury; Edmund and Priya's almost-kiss interrupted by the weight of what they now carry.

chapters.title: The Best Recipe
chapters.summary: POV Edmund. Threatened with suspension days before prom, Edmund chooses to speak anyway, weaving his mother's story into his championship argument as students hold up photocopies of the deed. The board resigns; the garden is restored in her name. On the dance floor, Priya takes his hand. Emotional beat: catharsis — Edmund finally wins by refusing to play it safe, claiming both truth and love.
